code: library(anthroDisturbanceUtils)  disturbanceList <- list(   mining = list(mining = terra::vect("POLYGON ((0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 1, 0 0))", crs = "EPSG:3857")),   roads = list(roads = terra::vect("LINESTRING (0 0, 2 2)", crs = "EPSG:3857")) ) generalPath <- file.path(tempdir(), "disturbanceList")  wrapTerraList(disturbanceList, generalPath, zipFiles = TRUE) layers <- unwrapTerraList("theList.rds", generalPath)

title: Write a list of disturbance layers to disk, and read it back — wrapTerraList
Write a list of disturbance layers to disk, and read it back — wrapTerraList
code: disturbanceList <- list(   mining = list(     mining = terra::vect("POLYGON ((0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 1, 0 0))", crs = "EPSG:3857")   ),   roads = list(roads = terra::vect("LINESTRING (0 0, 2 2)", crs = "EPSG:3857")) ) generalPath <- file.path(tempdir(), "disturbanceList") index <- wrapTerraList(disturbanceList, generalPath) str(index) #> List of 2 #>  $ mining:List of 1 #>   ..$ mining: chr "mining_mining.rds" #>  $ roads :List of 1 #>   ..$ roads: chr "roads_roads.rds"  layers <- unwrapTerraList("theList.rds", generalPath) #> Recovering mining_mining.rds #> Recovering roads_roads.rds layers$roads$roads #> class       : SpatVector #> geometry    : lines #> dimensions  : 1, 0  (geometries, attributes) #> extent      : 0, 2, 0, 2  (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax) #> coord. ref. : WGS 84 / Pseudo-Mercator (EPSG:3857)

title: anthroDisturbanceUtils 0.0.1
text: Initial version. archive writer reader anthropogenic disturbance modules move , modules share one copy (tati-micheletti/anthroDisturbance_DataPrep#8). unwrapTerraList() reads disturbance list back theList.rds disturbanceList.zip. looks layers generalPath, whatever directory index names, works terra attached (fixes tati-micheletti/anthroDisturbance_DataPrep#7, tati-micheletti/anthroDisturbance_Generator#5 tati-micheletti/potentialResourcesNT_DataPrep#5). wrapTerraList() writes disturbance list one .rds file per layer plus index theList.rds, optionally disturbanceList.zip. Layer files named sector class, random, index holds file names, full paths.
